purpose: Dated primary-source research evidence for GhostPay PR #72; not runtime feed configuration or on-chain qualification.
retrieval_method: curl HTTPS GET through the inherited session network configuration; HTTP 200 reported for both requests.
timestamp_basis: UTC modification time of each original completed curl output file before copying the exact bytes into this repository; repository checkout/copy modification times are not retrieval times. No HTTP Date, ETag or response-signature evidence was captured.
hash_scope: SHA-256 over exact downloaded file bytes; original JSON formatting retained.

sources.network_binding: Official documentation src/features/data/chains.ts binds the RDD URL to the network; src/config/data/chains.json supplies the chain ID. These are not fields in the downloaded RDD JSON.
